headline: Binance Suffers Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist Linked to North Korea
summary: The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, Binance, was hit by a $6.3 billion hack, marking the largest crypto heist in history. Experts identified North Korea as the likely culprit, and Binance is attempting to freeze affected assets while pledging to cover losses.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, and security breaches of this magnitude pose systemic risks to digital asset markets, investor confidence, and regulatory scrutiny across the sector.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The exchange suffered a record $6.3 billion exploit affecting its platform assets.
